mapper.sql:
WITH filtered AS ( SELECT , price FROM house_record
), ranked AS ( SELECT group_key, group_label, price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY group_key ORDER BY price) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY group_key) AS cnt FROM filtered ), percentiles AS ( SELECT group_key, group_label, cnt AS count, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS mean, ROUND(COALESCE(STDDEV_POP(price), 0), 2) AS std_dev, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rn IN ( FLOOR((cnt + 1) / 2), FLOOR((cnt + 2) / 2) ) THEN price END), 2) AS median, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = GREATEST(1, CEIL(cnt * 0.25)) THEN price END), 2) AS p25, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = GREATEST(1, CEIL(cnt * 0.75)) THEN price END), 2) AS p75 FROM ranked GROUP BY group_key, group_label, cnt )
mapper.select: SELECT group_label AS `group`, group_key AS groupKey, count, median, mean, p25, p75, std_dev AS stdDev FROM percentiles ORDER BY CAST(group_key AS DECIMAL(20, 4)) ASC, group_key ASC
SELECT group_label AS `group`, group_key AS groupKey, count, median AS medianPrice FROM percentiles ORDER BY CAST(group_key AS DECIMAL(20, 4)) ASC, group_key ASC
